component.name: Immich-Go GUI
component.summary: Desktop GUI for immich-go bulk media operations

description.p: Immich-Go GUI is an unofficial, user-friendly graphical interface for the immich-go CLI tool. It simplifies uploading, archiving, and organizing photos and videos on your Immich server.

Whether you are migrating from Google Photos with Takeout archives, uploading local folders, Apple Photos, or archiving your Immich server, this tool provides a native, robust interface to manage tasks without touching the terminal.

ul.li: Upload from local folders, Google Photos Takeout archives, Apple Photos, and more.
Archive photos and metadata from your Immich server.
Organize assets and manage RAW+JPEG/HEIC+JPEG stacking automatically.
Extensive filtering options for dates, albums, tags, and camera models.
